title: Refund policy
text: Customers may request a refund within 14 days if the service was not used. Escalate exceptions to a human reviewer.

title: Account lockout
text: If a user is locked out, verify identity first, then reset MFA or password according to the identity policy.

title: Equipment maintenance
text: An abnormal equipment reading should be routed to a qualified technician with the observation and relevant guidance; the assistant must not authorise operation or maintenance work.

title: AI governance
text: High-risk AI outputs require logging, source citation, human review and periodic evaluation.
